_why_the_series_3_is_an_edition_and_not_: The maker's own page carries the Series 3 text inside the 3P page and says the Series 3 « can be fully upgraded to an Alpha DAC Reference Series 3P ». Two names, one upgradable object, and no fact on the page distinguishes them: that is the definition of `edition` here, not of `neighbour`. If a fact ever separates them - a rate, a filter, a converter - the edition becomes a record of its own.
